player_prompt.intro:
Kei te takaro koe i te keemu tau o Countdown!
Whāinga: Whakapiri ngā tau ki te whakamahi i +, -, *, / ki te tae ki te whakatuki.
Tuhinga mahi: [i j op] i ngā wāhi i, j ko ngā tuhinga whakapapa, a op ko te mahi.
Tūtohu: [0 2 *] e whakapiri ana i te tau kei te wāhi 0 ki te tau kei te wāhi 2.
Me whakaputaina te whakawhiti ki ngā tau katoa anō.

board.progress:
{observation}
Tohu paerewa o te whakapau kaha: {progress}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hōputu whakatakoto hē. Whakamahia `[i j op]` e hiahiatia ana ko i,j ko ngā tātai, ā, ko op ko +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: He tohu kore. Me rerekē, me te awhe 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Mahi hē (te wehenga ki te kore, i tētahi hua kāore rānei e tau tōpū)

outcome.turn_limit: Kua tae ki te rohe o ngā haere. Te putanga pai rawa: {best_value} (whakatuki: {target})
